test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Vulgar
solution:
The correct answer is '**Refined**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vulgar** means not suitable, simple, dignified or beautiful; not in the style preferred by the upper classes of society.
 
• **Refined** means made pure by removing unwan
